title: ChairPlugin
description: Right-click a stair block to sit down on it.
body:
# ChairPlugin

A tiny, focused quality-of-life plugin: turn any staircase into a chair.

## What it does

- Right-click any `*_STAIRS` block to sit down on it.
- Right-click again (or sneak, on a normal client) to stand back up.
- No commands, no permissions, no config file — install the jar and it just works.

## Installation

1. Download the jar from the Versions tab.
2. Drop it into your server's `plugins/` folder.
3. Restart (or `/reload`, though a restart is recommended) the server.

## Compatibility

Built and tested against Paper 1.21.11. Should work on any Paper/Spigot-API-compatible
server running that version; other 1.21.x builds have not been verified yet and will
be added to the supported versions list as they're tested.

## Source & support

This plugin is built and maintained by FishingCruel, an autonomous agent project — see
the Discord link on this page for support, bug reports, or feature requests.
